candidate_sentences.text: Apartment sales decreased to 120 from 222, while apartment-sale revenue fell to EUR 27.6 million from EUR 44.9 million.
Conditions improved sequentially in the second quarter, when 84 apartments were sold and development revenue reached EUR 22.6 million, compared with EUR 21.6 million a year earlier.

verified_key_information_units.information: Market outlook: Construction input price pressures persisted; Vilnius apartment market moderated, Riga saw increased activity in lower-priced segments, Tallinn remained stable with high price sensitivity.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report, Outlook of Construction and Real Estate Market section

candidate_sentences.text: Management reported increased activity in both segments during the second quarter, but also rising construction material and equipment prices, with no expected easing of price pressures.
Public-sector, defence and Rail Baltica projects continued to support demand while private-sector customers remained cautious and price-sensitive.

verified_key_information_units.information: Profitability metrics: Pre-tax profit margin fell to 7.2% in H1 2026 (from 14.0% in H1 2025); net profit margin 8.6% (vs. 12.9%); EPS EUR 0.73 in H1 2026 (vs. EUR 1.22 in H1 2025).
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Ratios table, Management Report Overview, Note 4

candidate_sentences.text: The pre-tax margin fell to 7.2% from 14.0% and the net profit margin to 8.6% from 12.9%.

verified_key_information_units.information: Liquidity position: Cash and cash equivalents increased to EUR 39.6 million (from EUR 25.9 million); equity EUR 251.1 million (57.4% of assets); net debt EUR 29.6 million as of 30 June 2026.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report, Cash Position section; Consolidated Statement of Financial Position

candidate_sentences.text: Cash and cash equivalents were EUR 39.6 million versus EUR 25.9 million, but operating cash flow worsened to negative EUR 31.6 million, mainly reflecting higher inventories and construction-contract balances.
Additional development borrowing raised net debt to EUR 29.6 million and the debt ratio to 15.8% from 6.1%.

verified_key_information_units.information: Dividend payment: EUR 22.1 million (EUR 1.25 per share) approved for 2025 net profit, representing a 55% payout rate.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Dividends and Dividend Policy section, Note 4

candidate_sentences.text: The company paid EUR 22.1 million in dividends, or EUR 1.25 per share.

verified_key_information_units.information: Post-reporting-period event: Construction commenced for 50 apartments in the Lahekalda VII development project in Tallinn after 30 June 2026.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management Report, Real Estate Development section
